say:1:1530202501:1.text: No... I think I'll stay here.
say:1:1530202501:1.source_cn: 不……我应该不会回去，而是留在这里。
say:1:1530202501:1.male: No... I think I'll stay here.
say:1:1530202501:1.female: No... I think I'll stay here.

say:2:1530202502:1.text: There's nothing for me in the city anymore. Might as well help the Wildborn here grow wheat.
say:2:1530202502:1.source_cn: 反正我在城里也没有家人，不如留下来，协助这里的兽人种小麦。
say:2:1530202502:1.male: There's nothing for me in the city anymore. Might as well help the Wildborn here grow wheat.
say:2:1530202502:1.female: There's nothing for me in the city anymore. Might as well help the Wildborn here grow wheat.

say:3:1530202503:1.text: At least here, the memories of my friends still live on.
say:3:1530202503:1.source_cn: 这里……起码还有我和朋友的记忆。
say:3:1530202503:1.male: At least here, the memories of my friends still live on.
say:3:1530202503:1.female: At least here, the memories of my friends still live on.
